items.title: Phil Wilson interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 27, 2023
items.q: I told Hank Jones that years later when he was at some festival. He got a good laugh out of it.

ctx.x: And tried to make it, you know I would sit at the piano and say well if the saxes are doing this then maybe the trombones could do that and trial and error.

Can I — I’ve got to tell you, this is a true story now. When we were in Exeter in this big dorm that my dad — my room was on the third floor of our apartment and the piano was on the first floor. And I’m listening to Jazz at the Philharmonic Volume 9 or 10, and in it Hank Jones is playing the piano and Bill Harris is playing the trombone and Dizzy you know and it’s a ten inch you know. And in the middle of I think it was Bill Harris’s solo Hank Jones hits a D/C7, in other words the upper structure triad, right?…
